total.reason: a number, not a text: Library.history_count() or len(jobs) (an int) for show_history_count

written.reason: a number, not a text: HistoryWriter.written, the int count of writes done after a wait

name.reason: the subscription name the owner typed (or the first start link cut to 65 characters, user data); shown as typed in the two log lines of save_subscription, as in 1.7.0

data['last_new'].reason: a number, not a text: the stored int count of new entries of the last check

row['pending'].reason: a number, not a text: the int count of pending entries Library.subscriptions() computes (the fourth cell of subscription_row, checked cell by cell since A11.4, and the pending count of _subscription_selection)

search.reason: the owner's own search text (typed into the history search box, user data shown as typed) that show_history_count puts, cut to 30 characters as in 1.7.0, into library.history.none_found; its parameter is a sink parameter (A15), so the entry stands at the two callers
